inspectionTickets.problem: Insufficient modeled sanitary pipe slope. Measured at 1/8" per foot.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: Florida Plumbing Code Section 704.1 requires minimum 1/4" per foot slope for 3" diameter pipe.
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Pipe modeled horizontally with only 0.125 in/ft fall.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Adjust pipe hanger elevation drop by 0.5 inches over 20ft run to achieve 0.25 in/ft slope.

inspectionTickets.problem: Slab top elevation is 10.5 ft NAVD88; Flood Zone AE Base Flood Elevation is 11.0 ft NAVD88.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: ASCE 24-14 / Florida Building Code requires Finished Floor Elevation minimum +1 ft above BFE (12.0 ft).
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Building finished floor modeled 1.5 ft below mandatory flood elevation line.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Add 18" engineered compacted fill soil pad under slab to raise finished floor elevation to +12.5 ft NAVD88.

inspectionTickets.location: Roof Truss to Wall Plate Tie-Down Fasteners
inspectionTickets.problem: Truss hurricane clip fastener spec lists electro-galvanized nails.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: FBC HVHZ Section 2319 requires Hot-Dip Galvanized or Stainless Steel 316 clips within 2 miles of saltwater coast.
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Electro-galvanized fasteners specified, prone to premature salt air rust.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Update fastener schedule to Simpson Strong-Tie HDG / SS316 Hurricane Straps with SS ring-shank nails.

changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Add 18" compacted structural fill pad under slab to reach +12.5 ft NAVD88 elevation.

changeOrderRisks.issue: Roof truss hurricane clip fastener corrosion near salt water.
changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Swap electro-galvanized fasteners to 316 Stainless Steel prior to inspection sign-off.

components.assembly: 48" Deep Poured Concrete Frost Wall Footing over 2" Rigid Extruded Polystyrene (XPS) R-10 Insulation

whySelected.reason: 48" footing depth extends below Indiana 36" frost penetration depth line.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: 64 annual freeze/thaw cycles require air-entrained concrete (5.5% air voids) to prevent spalling.
whySelected.codeRule: Indiana Residential Code Section R403.1.4 frost protection.
whySelected.costImpact: Standard practice for Zone 5A cold climate basements.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Air-entrained concrete preserves structural integrity across 100+ winter cycles.

components.assembly: 6" Monolithic Post-Tensioned Concrete Slab over Stego Wrap Vapor Barrier

whySelected.reason: Post-tensioned slab selected due to coastal Tampa Bay sandy soil condition.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Groundwater table at 4.5 ft requires heavy vapor barrier.
whySelected.codeRule: Florida Building Code 2023 Section 1808 shallow foundation rules.
whySelected.costImpact: Saves 15% vs driven piles while guaranteeing 4000 PSI strength.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Encapsulated tendons protect against salt air corrosion.

components.assembly: 8" CMU Masonry Wall + #5 Rebar @ 24" o.c. + Stucco Finish

whySelected.reason: CMU block delivers 160 MPH wind shear capacity for Tampa Bay coastal storms.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Resists salt spray and zero rot risk at ground level.
whySelected.codeRule: Florida Building Code Section 1609 Wind Load Provisions.
whySelected.costImpact: Optimal local trade availability in Florida market.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: 50+ year structural lifespan.

components.assembly: 8" CMU Masonry Wall + #5 Rebar @ 24" o.c. + Stucco Finish

whySelected.reason: Reinforced CMU wall anchors building East corner against hurricane loads.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Zero termite vulnerability.

whySelected.reason: Protects north aspect against storm surges.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Minimal maintenance.

whySelected.reason: Protects west elevation.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Solar heat gain reduction with insulation core.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Durable finish.

components.assembly: 2x4 Wood Stud Interior Wall + 5/8" Gypsum Board Both Sides

whySelected.reason: Provides clear visual separation between Living Room and Kitchen with 45 STC acoustic dampening.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Easy electrical conduit routing.

components.assembly: 11-7/8" Engineered Wood I-Joists @ 16" o.c. + 3/4" T&G OSB Subfloor

whySelected.reason: Engineered I-joists deliver clear-span rigidity without floor squeaks.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Low thermal mass for upper floor efficiency.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Dimensional stability resists bowing.

components.assembly: 2x6 Wood Framing @ 16" o.c. + R-21 Insulation + Zip System Sheathing

whySelected.reason: Integrated air barrier Zip System prevents wind-driven rain penetration at upper level.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: R-21 continuous cavity insulation complies with Climate Zone 2A.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Sealed tape seams guarantee zero air leakage.

components.assembly: Engineered Timber Roof Trusses @ 24" o.c. + Standing Seam Aluminum Metal Roof

whySelected.reason: Kynar aluminum standing seam roof offers maximum solar reflectance and high corrosion immunity.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Reflects 70% solar radiation in Florida hot-humid climate.
whySelected.codeRule: FBC 2023 High Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) Roof Standards.
whySelected.costImpact: Higher initial cost, 50-year zero maintenance warranty.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: 100% recyclable material.

components.assembly: Fiberglass Impact-Resistant Entry Door with Multipoint Locking

whySelected.reason: Large missile impact rating eliminates storm shutter requirement.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Zero rot or warping.

components.assembly: Vinyl Frame Double-Pane Low-E Impact Window

whySelected.reason: Low-E Argon glass reduces solar heat gain coefficient (SHGC) to 0.22.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Lifetime vinyl seal warranty.

whySelected.reason: 200 Amp main panel satisfies code for all modern HVAC and residential loads.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Surge protection installed for lightning-prone Tampa area.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Silver-plated copper bus bar.

components.assembly: 15A 125V Tamper-Resistant Duplex Receptacle + 12/2 NMB Copper Wire

whySelected.reason: Tamper-resistant receptacle mandated by NEC for child safety.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Heavy-duty nylon faceplate.

components.assembly: 3" Schedule 40 PVC DWV Waste Pipe & 3/4" Uponor PEX-a Supply Lines

whySelected.reason: PEX-a expansion fitting technology eliminates leak risk in coastal acidic water.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Zero scale buildup in hard water conditions.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: 25-year manufacturer warranty.

whySelected.reason: EPA WaterSense certification reduces municipal water demand by 20%.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Water conservation priority in Florida aquifer region.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Glazed trapway prevents clogging.

components.assembly: 16 SEER2 Variable Speed Inverter Heat Pump Air Handler Unit

whySelected.reason: 16 SEER2 heat pump provides high dehumidification performance for Florida humidity.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Dehumidifies air down to 48% RH to prevent mold growth.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: R-410A / R-32 eco refrigerant.

components.assembly: Aluminum 4-Way Ceiling Air Diffuser + R-8 Flexible Duct Connection

whySelected.reason: Delivers balanced 150 CFM air distribution across living room.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Powder-coated aluminum finish.

properties.sourceEvidence: Mandatory 1/4" per foot minimum slope prevents solid waste settling and sewer gas entrapment.

properties.sourceEvidence: Microscopic air voids (4.5% - 7.5%) allow expanding frozen water relief without micro-cracking matrix.

learnedLessons.whatWorked: Monolithic post-tensioned slab eliminated differential soil settlement on soft coastal sand.
learnedLessons.whatFailed: Initial pipe modeling allowed 1/8" per foot slope on 3" sanitary line, failing plumbing inspection.
learnedLessons.whatRequiredRepair: Lowered sanitary pipe hangers 0.5" over 20ft run to achieve required 0.25 in/ft slope.
